than immediate errors.

ev-kb-ff11feff4e2a.summary:
[SUPERSEDED] [Ledger Pool Tuning (2024) > Ledger Pool Tuning (2024)] > This page predates the ledger-db capacity limits introduced in 2025 and is kept for history.

When `PoolTimeout` errors appear on ledger-service, raise `LEDGER_DB_POOL_MAX` to 80 per replica and
restart ledger-service. In 2024 ledger-db ran with `max_connections = 1000`, so this was always safe.

returns raw database errors; a `LEDGER_WRITE_FAILED` code always means the ledger write failed
downstream. Errors from ledger-service are logged with `upstream=ledger-service` and the upstream
status code.
